title: The Harvest Garland

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Every Harvest Home, the chapel door gets a garland of autumn flowers.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Will you make it this year? Keep to the pattern, so it's as pretty as can be.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flowers. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: yellow, yellow, red, blue. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: What a garland! The chapel door will look wonderful.

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Gold and red, like the autumn leaves. Our friends will see it as they come in from the roads.

journal_line: I made the harvest garland for the chapel door with Mrs. Ruth.
